initialize_preprocessor: initialize a distributed data preprocessor for in-memory or precomputed data processing
consume_data: consume raw data items and apply processor functions to produce preprocessed data iterators
consume_once_data: consume raw data items once and produce an infinite cycling iterator of preprocessed data
build_precomputed_data: build precomputed data files on disk for reuse across training runs with distributed ranks
manage_in_memory_buffer: manage an in-memory data buffer with configurable max limit for preprocessed data items
